title: Weekly Classes
heading: Weekly *Classes*
description: Toddler Tuesday open play and Drop-Off & Play Thursday for children 18 months and up in Staten Island.
intro: Learn, play and grow together, with open play for toddlers and a gentle drop-off program.

cards.title: Toddler Tuesday
cards.subtitle: Safe exploring for toddlers, social time for caregivers
cards.text: A specialty open play session for toddlers, with a complimentary cup of fresh coffee for the grown-ups.

facts.label: Pricing
facts.value: $15 per session with a monthly commitment, or $20 walk-in

facts.label: How to join
facts.value: Walk-ins are always welcome. Sign-ups are appreciated.

cards.title: Drop-Off & Play Thursday
cards.subtitle: Gentle separation, real confidence
cards.text: A child-led session that eases early separation and encourages gentle socialization at your child's own pace. Premier preschool prep, and two free hours for you.

facts.label: Ages
facts.value: 18 months and up. Potty training is not required.

cards.title: Special Guest Teachers
cards.subtitle: Fresh, unique learning experiences
cards.text: We routinely host outside educators and creators for pop-up classes. Follow us on Instagram for upcoming themes and schedules, or text us so you never miss a special class.
